translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yon wok ban boyamin kinim ami leiw kidel keimin sung uta ko.
Kale kanamsiw kabadák ayo Yon wok ban boyámin kinim ayo Yuddia bakan kalo yak anang iwán sed gisa bakan kal weng dawkáyam ká bom
nadale bakoda, “kiba ban keimin uyo ibik dumamin kala. Watawo kaleyo bá, Got ami kasák gu uyo mewso tadbu kala.” Kalansa.
Kale ami kanaba be suwayo Got alata ami guton lum senin kinim Aiseya dim kal bako nadale,

content.text: “kinim mak anang iwán sed gisa bakan kal gán dá, ‘kiba, Kamokim ami leiw uyo kidela tudon leiw kuw keidaw sidiwano.’”

content: Kalesa.
Kale Yon ami ilim mikimin be iniman kemal kalim ade am idet mikimin be iniman kal tuw wol kil kakam falala dauyamsa ade am wanin ayo ki madá kueing kubudum so kin wok so ki wananámsa ko.
Wanang kinim iyo Yedusalem kalo tade bidiw, wáw Yuddia anang bakan adikum kalo tade bidiw, wáw wok Yoddan anang bakan kalo tade bidiw kei bom nadiwe yak ataman bom nadiwo
ilimi ban keimin uyo kuw misun tei bidiwo, Yon ata Yoddan wok bang kal wok bomin ban boyamsa.
Kata kanomin Fedasi so Saddusi so iyo tad Yon wok ban boyaba bán tadiwe, aka itam bakoyam, “Mafakim muduw kiba! Kan ata bakoyamano, Got ami aket keng atud uyo fingon dá sakaboduwo, kalbiwe?
Kiba kukuw kidel kuw faku tadiwo, itam kiba ban keimin uyo ibik wakumamiwe kaleyono,

ude kiba aket fukan dá bako nadiwade, ‘Ebadakkam be nulum awadiko’ kalin bá. Watawo kaleyo bá, kiba Ebadakkam am kukuw taw fakudongin banim, kayo kiba am maduw bá ka. Got aka ken Ebadakkam man low takudawon kaloma uyo aka ken tum seng seng bula kumadela matam Ebadakkam muduw keidoliw kala.
Kale kabak uyo as wakeládi bakan abu ko. Kale as mit kuti faskoba. Kale yak as gim kidel mak abumongin dakosu, be wakela dibinoda yak as abokaba kala.

Kiba ban keimin ibik dukámabiw, kayo naka wok ban kuw boyamokabi. Kata kinim mak nam yán tem tadokaba aka nataw bá, aka kinim abem kitid soim, kale naka fák am as fakiw dádawomi banim. Ata Got Sinik Abem so imkukumin mámin so kudew tad kiwa imudokaba ko.
Got aka dukák dákadula tad tad keidune aka wom so wod so bo takel dáda dák abune, yak dam ki faku kudew tam am dawti nadale wom so wod so uta as sun kain bom biyámin as abudokaba ko.” Kalesa.
Yon Yesus wok ban bodawsa sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo Galili kalo tad bi tad wok Yoddan bang tadino, Yon ata wok ban bonamako kale nadayo tasa ko.
Kata Yon ayo Yesus daw tam modono kale nadale bakodaw, “kuina, watawo kale nata wok ban bonamako, kale tadáwe, bede kawta nam wok bonamongin make?” Akane,

Yesus weng atung fakadu bakodaw, “kamane bo kanodumo! Nuka kanodokabuw namti, Got alam aket kukuw kidel adikum kanoduko, kalba uyo matam dam abudokabu ka.” Kalane, afan Yon ayo alam weng bakoda ki abo kanodawsa.

Kale Yesus ayo wok ban bo nadale wok bá dabadá matam kei badale, alam kabadákal abid tikin ibin uyo bisu kaú madik una madik una audane, Yon ayo utamomane, Got Sinik Abem ayo awon samsam ulutaw madák Yesus kiwa dauda ka. Akane,
weng mak abid tikino kaw tam kalo bako nadale, “bela nalam man, nam aket dukum uyo amal kal bu ade naka am idak teinbi.” Kalesa ko.
